required_rules: Only allow catalog field IDs and valid current types/enums; reject unknown keys.
Null requires an explicit reason: missing, unreadable, redacted, not_applicable, stale, conflicting, or unsupported. Never default to zero or false.
Source page must be an integer from 1 to page_count; quote/span/region must resolve to observed content. Bounding box or text span is required, both preferred.
A derived observation must identify formula, input observation IDs, rounding, units, period and owner. Model arithmetic alone is insufficient.
Amounts require gross/net/taxable/received/elected/balance distinction and currency; dates require role such as entitlement/effective/issue/payment/service.
Whole-question answers assembled from components require completeness and allocation review; one income source cannot complete a household roster.
Keep conflicting observations with their effective periods; do not choose newest upload automatically.
Apply only user-confirmed values through existing validation/cleanup; preserve pending observations outside raw intake answers.
Retain evidence provenance separately from user_report metadata; preserve externally resolved facts and never silently overwrite them.
Exclude SSNs, ITINs, account/routing/claim/member/immigration numbers, signatures and machine-readable identifiers; no such fields in model output.
No eligibility conclusions, unseen-person matching, tool instructions or policy retrieval from personal documents.
Capture document lifecycle/deletion status outside model output; evidence link must disclose if original was deleted.
